get.summary: Generate an export for a completed quote nest
get.description:
The quote-nesting equivalent of `GET /v1/nesting/export`. Generates a quote-oriented export from a completed quote nest and delivers it **asynchronously to your webhook**.

Like `export`, this call does **not** return the export in the response body — it returns `{ "Success": true }` on acceptance and `POST`s the generated export to the `WebHookUri` you supply. There is no `ResponseType`; the quote export is a single fixed shape.

parameters.description: The completed quote nest to export, as returned from the quote-nesting endpoint.

parameters.description: The URL the generated export is `POST`ed to when it is ready. Required — without it the export has nowhere to be delivered.

get.summary: Generate a production export for a completed nest
get.description:
Generates an export from a completed nesting result and delivers it **asynchronously to your webhook**.

This call does **not** return the export in the response body. It validates the request **up front**, queues the export, and returns immediately with `{ "Success": true }`. When the export has been generated it is `POST`ed to the `WebHookUri` you supply.

The request is validated synchronously before it is queued — a malformed or unsatisfiable request is rejected here with a clear error rather than being accepted and failing silently later. See the responses below.

Use `ResponseType` to choose what is produced. Each type requires the matching settings block to have been supplied on the **original nesting request** (a missing block is rejected up front):

- `Result` (0) — part-placement details for the result. No settings required.
- `Render` (1) — a base64-encoded render (SVG or PNG) of the layout. Requires `RenderSettings`.
- `DXF` (2) — a base64-encoded DXF file of the nested layout. Requires `DXFExportSettings`.
- `ReportSource` (3) — statistics and base64 renderings for report generation. Requires `ReportSourceSettings`.
- `RemnantExport` (4) — a base64-encoded zip of DXF files representing the remnants. Requires `RemnantGenerationSettings`.
- `Runtime` (5) — information about the result together with a render. See `ReportSourceRenderingSettings` below: on a **GET** it uses the original request's `ReportSourceSettings` (rejected if none were supplied); **POST** to this endpoint to supply the render settings on the call itself.
- `PartsExport` (6) — a DXF export of the individual part geometry. Requires `PartExportSettings`.

Each `ResponseType` may be requested once per result by default; requesting an export you have already requested returns an error.

parameters.name: RequestId
parameters.description: The completed job to export. This is `NestIdentifier` in the webhook payload, and is the id returned from the nesting endpoint.

parameters.name: ResultId
parameters.description: The specific result to export. This is `ResultIdentity` in the webhook payload and in `GET /v1/nesting/status`.

parameters.name: ResponseType
parameters.description: Which export to generate. Accepts the name or the integer — see the endpoint description for the meaning of each value and the settings it requires.

parameters.name: WebHookUri
parameters.description: The URL the generated export is `POST`ed to when it is ready. Required, and must be an absolute HTTPS URL — without it the export has nowhere to be delivered.

200.description: The export request was accepted and queued for delivery to your webhook.

400.description: The request is malformed or unsatisfiable: a missing/non-empty `RequestId` or `ResultId`, a missing or non-HTTPS `WebHookUri`, an unknown `ResponseType`, or a `ResponseType` whose required settings block was not supplied on the original nesting request. The `ResponseStatus` message explains which check failed.

401.description: API key is missing or invalid.

404.description: No completed nest was found for the supplied `RequestId`/`ResultId` for this key, or the result is no longer available for export (results are retained in memory for a limited time).

409.description: The nest exists but is not in an exportable state — it has not completed yet, or it failed.

429.description: The per-type export limit for this result has been reached. Each `ResponseType` may be requested once per result by default.

For every other `ResponseType` the GET and POST forms behave identically.

ReportSourceRenderingSettings.description: Render settings for a `Runtime` export, supplied on a **POST** to this endpoint. When omitted (and always on a GET) the original nesting request's `ReportSourceSettings` are used instead; a `Runtime` export with neither is rejected. Ignored for every other `ResponseType`.

ReportSourceRenderingSettings.title: ReportSourceRenderingSettings

RenderPartLabelMode.description: How each part is labelled in the nest rendering (none, identifier, or part name). Values: `None` — No part labels; `ID` — Label each part with its identifier; `PartName` — Label each part with its part name.

PartLabelHeight.description: Height of the part label text, in millimetres. Left null for automatic sizing.

ReportSourceRenderingSettings.description: Settings for the renderings generated for a ReportSource: the per-nest layout render and the per-part preview render, plus how parts are labelled.

RenderSettings.title: RenderSettings

RenderFormat.description: The format to generate the nesting result render

xDimension.description: X dimension in pixels of the rendering

yDimension.description: Y dimension in pixels of the rendering

BackColorARGB.description: Background color of the rendering using the ARBG hex definition, e.g. #AARRGGBB

OutlineLineColorARGB.description: Part and sheet boundary color within the rendering using the ARBG hex definition, e.g. #AARRGGBB

PartFillColorARGB.description: Part fill color within the rendering using the ARBG hex definition, e.g. #AARRGGBB. Optional.

AutomaticallyChoosePartFillColor.description: True if client wants to the renderer to automatically assign each part a unique fill colour for renderings, these will be respected throughout the nesting process. If False a PartFillColorARBG value must be supplied.

RenderSettings.description: Settings for the generation of requested nesting result renderings

ParametricGeometryNestingRequest.title: ParametricGeometryNestingRequest
ParametricGeometryNestingRequest.description: Submit a nesting request from parametric part definitions. Async: returns a RequestId; the result is delivered to your ResultsWebhookUri.

Parts.description: The parts to nest, each carrying its own quantity and per-part options.

Sheets.description: Sheets to be considered for nesting of the Parts

Assemblies.description: Assemblies to be considered for nesting

Tag.description: Optional client-defined tag carried with the request, for your own correlation. Not interpreted by the nester.

ImportSettings.title: ImportSettings

CutLayers.description: Name of the layer in the geometry definition file that defines the cut boundary of the of the shape. This will be used to determine the outer and inner boundaries of the shapes to be nested

AttachLayers.description: List of layer names to be attached to shapes defined by the CutLayerName. This geometry should be within the body of the shape defined by the cut layer

UseAllPartsInFile.description: Import every part/block found in the file, rather than a single part.

CollateMultipleBlockInserts.description: Treat multiple inserts of the same block as a single collated part.

AppendPartNamesToIdentities.description: Append the source part/block name to each part identity. Mutually exclusive with UsePartNamesAsIdentityOnMultiPartImport; generally only useful with UseAllPartsInFile when block names overlap across multiple files.

UsePartNamesAsIdentityOnMultiPartImport.description: Use the source part/block name as the part identity on a multi-part import. Requires that part/block names are unique across the whole request.

AutomaticallyAttachUnusedCutAssignedGeom.description: Automatically attach cut-assigned geometry that was not otherwise used to the part that contains it.

LayerNameForAutomaticallyAttachedGeometr.description: Layer name used for geometry attached by AutomaticallyAttachUnusedCutAssignedGeometry.

MeasurementUnitsOfImportGeometry.description: Measurement units the imported geometry is defined in. Default is millimetres. Values: `Millimetres` — Millimetres; `Inches` — Inches.

FromScale.description: Source value of the scale conversion applied to imported geometry (a FromScale:ToScale ratio). Default 1.0.

ToScale.description: Target value of the scale conversion applied to imported geometry (a FromScale:ToScale ratio). Default 1.0.

ImportSettings.description: Instructions for the importer engine to extract geometry from the supplied files used to define parts and irregular sheets

ColourHex.description: Colour for assignment e.g. #FFFFFF (white) : Optional but if set you must also set LineType

LineType.description: Line type for assignment - case sensitive, often upper case e.g. CONTINUOUS : Optional but if set you must also set ColourHex

NestSettings.title: NestSettings

PartSpacing.description: Part to part spacing value to be used in the nesting process, per part spacing override values will overrule these during the nesting process if present

ReportIntermediateResults.description: True if the client wants to receive updates as a new, improved, nesting result is generated.

MaxRunTimeSeconds.description: The maximum time in seconds the nesting process should run for

UtilisationStopTarget.description: The % utilisation target for the nesting process. If this target percentage is reached the nesting process will automatically finish. Optional.

RepeatPreference.description: Nesting repeat preference for the nesting process Values: `BestEfficiency` — Create nests with the best efficiency possible, but with fewer repeated layouts; `BalancedRepeats` — Use repeated nests when efficiency is not affected too much; `PreferRepeats` — Reduce the number of different sheet layouts at the expense of material efficiency.

NestingDirection.description: Direction of nesting for the nesting process Values: `Zero` — No specific direction; nest naturally from the origin. This is the default and is always valid; `Ninety` — Pack the nest upward from the origin; `OneEighty` — Pack the nest to the left from the origin; `TwoSeventy` — Pack the nest downward from the origin.

NestingAngleDegrees.description: Optional nesting angle in degrees. When set, the whole layout is rotated by this angle and nested from the bottom-left, then reported back in the sheet's real orientation - so parts nest along the edge brought to the bottom. Always nests from the bottom-left origin and is mutually exclusive with NestingDirection. Leave null (the default) to nest without an angle.

MaximumCPUCount.description: The maximum number of CPUs the nesting process should try to use. Recommended maximum is (CPU count - 1) to allow client to operate unimpeded

NestingOrigin.description: The origin of the sheet the nesting process will begin from. Values: `BottomLeft` — Nest from the bottom-left corner of the sheet; `TopLeft` — Nest from the top-left corner of the sheet; `TopRight` — Nest from the top-right corner of the sheet; `BottomRight` — Nest from the bottom-right corner of the sheet.

AllowEnginePopups.description: Diagnostic use only. Allow the nesting engine to show UI pop-ups. Leave false for API use.

ExportDiagnosticData.description: Diagnostic use only. Export internal diagnostic data from the nesting run.

DiagnosticDataPath.description: Diagnostic use only. Path that diagnostic data is written to when ExportDiagnosticData is set.

MaximumDifferentSheetSizes.description: Maximum number of different sheet sizes to be used in the nesting results generated, 0 = no restriction

NestingObjective.description: The nesting Objective for the nesting algorithms to aim towards Values: `IntelligentMinimizeX` — Minimise the layout extent along X, but avoid poor placements of longer parts even where that does not strictly match the objective; `MinimizeXThenY` — Strictly minimise the layout extent along X, then along Y; `MinimizeArea` — Minimise the overall bounding area of the layout; `MinimizeYThenX` — Strictly minimise the layout extent along Y, then along X; `NoReusableOffcut` — Aim to leave no reusable offcut. Best used together with filler-part quantities; `IntelligentMinimizeY` — Minimise the layout extent along Y, but avoid poor placements of longer parts even where that does not strictly match the objective.

InnerLoopFillPreference.description: Gets or sets the preference for how the inner loop should be filled during nesting. Values: `None` — Do not instruct the nesting algorithm to treat holes (inner loops) specially; `DontNestInsideInnerLoops` — Never place parts inside the inner loops (holes) of other parts; `PreferNestingInsideInnerLoops` — Prefer placing parts inside the inner loops (holes) of other parts.

FillerPartsStrategy.description: Filler parts strategy to be used during the nesting process. This will determine how filler parts are placed in the nest.

StrictPartPriorities.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether part priorities are strictly enforced during nesting.

NestSettings.description: Settings for the nesting request to follow during the nesting process

DXFExportSettings.title: DXFExportSettings

DXFVersion.description: DXF revision the file is written as. CommonCutSettings.title: CommonCutSettings

CommonCuttingImportance.description: Importance of prioritising common cuts Values: `Unimportant` — Maximise material and give no specific value to common cutting; `Weak` — Give a light preference for common cutting (default); `Important` — Give more preference to common cutting; `VeryImportant` — Return solutions with lots of common-line cutting; may lose material; `NotSet` — Not specified; the engine default applies.

CommonCutSafety.description: How "safe" do you want the common cuts to be - recommend safe unless common cuts very valuable Values: `PairsOnly` — Only pair up parts; the most conservative option; `Safe` — Fast leaving conditions on the border of common cuts. Recommended; `Strong` — Intermediate between safe and aggressive; `Aggressive` — Aggressive common cutting; may lead to cutting problems; `NotSet` — Not specified; the engine default applies.

CommonCutLeadinCheck.description: Check any described lead in / outs with respect to the common cut (when lead in / outs are present) Values: `NoCheck` — No lead-in checking; `LinearTangential` — Simple prolongating linear lead-in that may be tangential to one of the parts; `LinearNonTangential` — The linear lead-in must be fully valid and not on the border of any part. Forbids partial common cut.

CommonCutMode.description: Choose which common cut mode is to be used - same part or different part Values: `None` — Common cutting is off; `SameParts` — The normal mode: share edges only between copies of the same part; `DifferentParts` — Experimental. Also share edges between different parts. Useful when you have many different parts in small quantities with long straight edges, saving both cutting time and material.

MaterialCostPerUnitSqr.description: Cost per area unit of material to allow for balancing common cut material savings for time savings

CuttingCostPerUnit.description: Cost per length unit of cutting to allow for balancing of time savings vs material costs

MinLengthOfCommonCut.description: Minimum length of any common cut generated

RegardingRatio.description: Controls the leaving condition around a common cut. Where edges near a common cut are closer than the normal part gap, heating or cut problems can occur if they stay close for too long; this "bad zone" is approximated by a "regarding length". This ratio caps that length relative to the normal part gap: 2.0 is strict, 8.0 is permissive.

CanIntroduceHolesFromCommonCut.description: Can the common cuts introduce holes in the layout

OnlyPairs.description: Only allow common cuts on pairs of parts

CommonCutPartsMaximumDimensionX.description: Maximum X dimension of any common cut "block" generated

CommonCutPartsMaximumDimensionY.description: Maximum Y dimension of any common cut "block" generated

AllowCommonCutOnHoles.description: Can the common cuts be applied in holes within parts

CommonCutGap.description: The gap between parts for common cut edges. Must be less than part spacing - normally kerf width for your cutting technology

CommonCutSettings.description: Common cut settings to enable and control common cuts

NestedSheetsInfo.description: Details of the sheets and nests that form the result

NumberOfPartsNested.description: Number of parts nested in the result. Not present if status is not Result.

NumberOfPartsUnPlaced.description: Number of parts not nested in the result. Not present if status is not Result.

NumberOfSheetsUsed.description: Number of sheets used in the result. Not present if status is not Result.

UnplacedParts.description: Information about parts which are not placed

NestingStatusMessage.description: Sent from Server to client when the status of the nesting process changes, i.e. it generates a result, completes or errors

Success.description: `true` if the next sub-nest was released.

ErrorReason.description: Why the continue failed when `Success` is `false`; otherwise null.

Success.description: `true` if the export request was accepted and queued. This is an acknowledgement only — the export itself is delivered later as a `POST` to your `WebHookUri`.

Error.description: Error detail when `Success` is `false`; otherwise null.

Valid.description: `true` when the calling API key is active.

Ready.description: `true` if the requested export is available in `PayloadJson`; `false` if it has not been generated or has expired.

RequestId.description: The job the export belongs to.

ResultId.description: The result the export belongs to.

ResponseType.description: The export type this response carries.

PayloadJson.description: The export itself, as JSON, when `Ready` is `true`; otherwise null.

CreatedUtc.description: When the cached export was generated (UTC).

ExpiresUtc.description: When the cached export expires and is no longer retrievable (UTC).

NumberOfUniqueNests.description: Number of unique nest patterns in the solution

Nests.description: The nest patterns that form the solution

Nesting1DNest.title: Nesting1DNest

Multiplicity.description: Number of copies of this nest pattern

PlacedLengths.description: The placed lengths within this nest pattern

Nesting1DNest.description: A single nest pattern within a 1D nesting result

Nesting1DPlacedLength.title: Nesting1DPlacedLength

PlacedX.description: The X position of this length within the nest

Nesting1DPlacedLength.description: A placed length within a 1D nest pattern
